title: FieldProvenance
description: Records how a specific field's value was obtained — manual entry, AI extraction, import, OCR, or computation

field.description: The field name this provenance record applies to

method.description: How the field value was obtained

verifiedAt.description: When this field was last verified

sourceDocumentId.description: Reference to the document.json entity this value was extracted from

sourcePageNumber.description: Page number in the source document where this value was found

sourceRegion.description: Location within the page where this value was found

originalText.description: The raw text as extracted before any normalisation or structuring. Preserves exactly what the source document said
examples: born on the 15th day of March nineteen forty eight
I appoint my wife Margaret Anne Frith

originalScript.description: Writing system of the source document. Critical for handwritten wills in non-Latin scripts
originalScript.$comment: latin: English, French, German, etc. kanji: Japanese kanji characters. hiragana/katakana: Japanese syllabaries. arabic: Arabic script (also used for Urdu, Farsi). hebrew: Hebrew script. devanagari: Hindi, Marathi, Sanskrit. tamil: Tamil script. chinese_simplified/traditional: Chinese characters. hangul: Korean. cyrillic: Russian, Serbian, etc. thai: Thai script. mixed: multiple scripts in one document. other: any other writing system.

ocrEngine.description: OCR engine or extraction tool used to obtain this value

extractedAt.description: When this value was extracted from the source document

dataSource.description: The third-party source that provided this field value. Enables attribution credits and the data source kill switch

source.description: Short identifier for the data source

sourceUrl.description: URL to the source's website or the specific page this data came from

retrievedAt.description: When this data was retrieved from the source
